subject: Deploy Doré Design 1.7 editable Journal workspace page
body: Pull merged PR #269 / merge b13462ccb6b16666706a416e497d38069d2d9a7b. Deploy Doré Design 1.7. Preserve the locked #262 homepage exactly. Import the current main-site Journal once into the durable journal-vol-00 workspace page; do not run Journal as a Hugo runtime mirror. Verify /journal/ is rendered from workspace, /editor?page=journal-vol-00 exposes the Journal in the multi-page editor, and the reversible workspace mutation acceptance changes /journal/ then restores the original text. Return exact deployment and acceptance evidence.
